Mesclun Salad
By: Anonymous
Published: Saturday, December 12, 2009 - 11:28pm

Ingredients




1 1/2 tablespoons Sugarcane vinegar, champagne vinegar, or 
1 pch Brown sugar
Coarse salt
Freshly ground pepper
2 Ta extra-virgin olive oil
6 ounces Mesclun salad greens





Preparation

1 In a large bowl, whisk together vinegar, brown sugar, salt, and pepper. 2 Whisk in olive oil, and adjust seasoning if necessary. Add greens, and toss to coat thoroughly with dressing; your hands are the best tools for this job.
